stem: Points \(A\), \(B\), and \(C\) lie on the circle with center \(O\), and angle \(AOB\) measures \(50^{\circ}\). What is the measure, in degrees, of angle \(ACB\)?
solution: Angle \(ACB\) is an inscribed angle that intercepts the same arc \(AB\) as central angle \(AOB\).
An inscribed angle is half the central angle: \(\frac{50}{2} = 25\).
verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert all(abs(d('O',p)-6)<0.01 for p in 'ABC')
assert abs(ang('A','O','B')-50)<0.1
ans=Rational(50,2)
assert abs(ang('A','C','B')-ans)<0.1
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==ans
